units.source_text: 岛村以为在山上呆了七天，只是为了恢复恢复健康，

en.t: Shimamura had thought that spending seven days in the mountains was only for restoring his health,

units.source_text: 如今才发觉实际上是由于头一回遇见了这样一个隽秀婀娜的女子。

en.t: only now did he realize that it was actually because he had met such a graceful and beautiful woman for the first time.
